methods.label: Compare area divided by mowing rate
methods.explanation:
Finishing time equals lawn area divided by mowing rate. Since only relative times matter, choose an area unit in which Andy’s lawn has area \(6\). Beth’s lawn then has area \(3\), and Carlos’ has area \(2\).

Choose a time unit in which Carlos’ mower cuts \(1\) area unit. Beth’s mower cuts \(2\) area units in that time, and Andy’s cuts \(3\). These choices change only the units, preserving all the given relationships.

Their mowing times, in the same time unit, are therefore
\[
\text{Andy: }\frac{6}{3}=2,\qquad
\text{Beth: }\frac{3}{2},\qquad
\text{Carlos: }\frac{2}{1}=2.
\]
Because \(\frac32<2\), Beth finishes first, choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
